description:
Cast Psychic Miasma by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Extus triggers, returning Dryad Arbor to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve Psychic Miasma, discarding Dryad Arbor and returning Psychic Miasma to your hand.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
